name: patent-cli
description: Google Patents lookup for Codex. Provides MCP tools for patent metadata lookup and field discovery, plus documented gp-cli commands for PDFs, figures, bulk runs, configuration, and updates.

interface.shortDescription: Google Patents lookup and gp-cli workflows
interface.longDescription: Use MCP tools to fetch Google Patents metadata and list available fields. The bundled skills also document when to run gp-cli directly for PDF downloads, figure images, bulk processing, proxy/CA configuration, request delays, and updates.
